questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming. Be ready for traffic from other directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to clear before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights from bottom to top show green, yellow, then red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a hand signal for a right turn. The rider's left arm is bent at the elbow with the hand pointing up. It means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it to their side, it signals following riders to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop at a red light, go at a green light, or watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only moves one way on this road. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to let other traffic merge in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the rider is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and swings it upward, it tells the group to increase speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and stay farther away from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (yellow with black markings). It tells you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (yellow with black markings). It tells you to be careful because the road may become slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you the direction traffic must go on this road. You must drive in the direction the sign shows.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you see it. Trains cannot move out of your way, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs mark railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is near. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (yellow with black markings). It tells you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.
